issues: The sentence (34px in design units) and a 92px slot filled only a thin strip at mid-frame, leaving the rest empty like a single line of web copy
The avatars were grey discs with emoji or line icons, so they did not read as people and the four teammates looked nearly identical
The role label was 10px text, close to unreadable in the 1080p output, and the blurred queue below interfered with it during changes
A cool black ground with an indigo bracket and no layout scaffolding made it look like every other dark UI shot in the library
changes: Switched to the paper look as a Swiss poster: the sentence is now 150px/800 heavy grotesk, the slot is 260px with vermilion corner brackets as the only accent, and a 12-column hairline grid, eyebrow, counter and progress pills form the scaffold

Redrew the avatars as illustrated portraits (earthy backgrounds, shoulders, heads, four hairstyles and glasses); the queue steps 236px and neighbours shrink to 0.6 with distance blur, hinting at more people behind

Switches are now physical springs (damping 15, one visible overshoot) on beats 40 / 74 / 108f, with velocity-based vertical stretch and motion blur while moving; the bracket breathes out 7% and bites back on the same beat

The role label is a paper name-tag chip with index, 52px role and first name; its solid fill hides the blurred queue below, it scrolls with pos, and a 2.4 falloff keeps two labels from ever sharing the frame

Opening: both words rise from the baseline, the corners overshoot in from 70px outside to lock, and the avatars float in on a 4f stagger; 26f landing hold, with the camera pushing 1→1.03 very slowly throughout
